Name: More Pet Bowls
Author: DellyBelly
Description:
[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Uses the new 1.6 feature to add new building variants, rather than replacing vanilla sprites
[*]Visit Robin to build a colourful pet bowl or to paint an existing pet bowl
[*]Works with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿, use the Paint Bucket on pet bowls
[*]Provides 100+ pet bowl variants to choose from
[*] 8 colours: Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Cyan, Blue, Purple, Pink
[*]3 designs: Plain, Bone, Fish
[*]4 floors: Vanilla Wood, Vanilla Hay, Vanilla Stone, No Floor
[/list]

[size=5][b]How to Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Download and unzip the mod into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i]
>> alternatively consider using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop [/url]﻿to manage your mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][size=5]Configure[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod includes a config.json
[*]Default values only include the "No Floor" option
[*]You can modify the json with "true" or "false" values
[*]You can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ if you prefer
[*]Changes apply on save load
[/list][size=5][b]
Compatability[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+ compatible
[*]compatible with[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246] Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
[*]Do you want cheaper pets and/or pet bowls? Install my other mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21880]Cheaper Pets[/url]﻿

[/list]
[size=5][b]Thank you[/b][/size]
If you've made it this far and you install the mod, thank you. I hope you enjoy it.
And of course a big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] ﻿for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
